Statement

Step 3. Applying the elliptic interpolation theorem to \(Q_{01280013}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the nonlinear convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01280011 \cdot C_01280012 \cdot C_01280013\).
